title: Requesting a Revised Gerber File
en: Please send us the revised Gerber files by tomorrow so that we can proceed with the PCB review.
zh: 請於明天之前提供修訂後的 Gerber 檔案，以便我們繼續進行 PCB 審查。
notes: 清楚說明需要對方提供什麼、截止時間，以及原因。正式郵件可在前面加上 Could you please…，語氣會更客氣。

title: Confirming the Project Timeline
en: Good morning, everyone. Today we will discuss the project timeline and the next steps.
zh: 大家早安。今天我們要討論專案時程以及接下來的步驟。
notes: 會議開場常用 discuss the timeline 與 next steps。也可以說：Let's review the schedule.

title: Reporting a Quality Issue
en: We found a potential issue during testing, and our team is investigating the root cause.
zh: 我們在測試期間發現一個潛在問題，目前團隊正在調查根本原因。
notes: 品質問題常用 potential issue、investigate 與 root cause。

title: Following Up with a Supplier
en: Could you please confirm the delivery date and let us know if there are any changes?
zh: 請問您能否確認交貨日期，並告知我們是否有任何變更？
notes: Could you please… 是禮貌提出請求的句型。let us know 可用於請對方告知最新狀況。

title: Understanding a Meeting Update
en: The meeting has been moved to Thursday afternoon because the client needs more time to review the proposal.
zh: 因為客戶需要更多時間審查提案，會議已改到星期四下午。
notes: 聽力要抓住時間變更、原因與人物需求。has been moved to 表示已改到某個時間。

title: Confirming PCB Specifications
en: Please confirm the PCB specifications before we release the final Gerber package.
zh: 在我們釋出最終 Gerber 檔案之前，請先確認 PCB 規格。
notes: before + 子句表示「在……之前」。release 在工程情境常指正式釋出檔案或版本。

title: Opening a Formal Email
en: I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to follow up on the quotation we discussed last week. Please let me know if you need any additional information.
zh: 希望您一切安好。我寫信是想追蹤上週我們討論過的報價。如果您需要任何其他資訊，請告訴我。
notes: I am writing to… 是正式郵件說明來意的標準開頭；follow up on 表示「追蹤某件事」。

title: Apologizing for a Delay
en: Please accept our apologies for the delay in shipment. Due to a shortage of raw materials, the order will arrive three days later than scheduled. We appreciate your patience.
zh: 出貨延遲，敬請見諒。由於原物料短缺，訂單將比預定時間晚三天抵達。感謝您的耐心。
notes: due to + 名詞 表示原因；later than scheduled 比預定晚。道歉後給出原因與新時程，再感謝對方。

title: Attaching Documents
en: Please find attached the updated contract for your review. I have highlighted the changes in yellow. We would appreciate your feedback by Friday.
zh: 附件是更新後的合約，請您審閱。我已用黃色標示修改處。希望您能在週五前回覆意見。
notes: Please find attached… 是附件的固定說法；We would appreciate… 是委婉請求。

title: Asking for Clarification
en: Sorry, could you clarify what you mean by a phased rollout? Do you plan to launch the product in one region first?
zh: 抱歉，可以說明一下您說的「分階段推出」是什麼意思嗎？您是打算先在一個地區推出產品嗎？
notes: Could you clarify… 是禮貌要求對方說明的句型；phased rollout 指分階段上線。

title: Summarizing Action Items
en: To wrap up, let me summarize the action items. Kevin will update the budget, and Lisa will contact the vendor. We will meet again next Tuesday.
zh: 最後，我來總結一下待辦事項。Kevin 會更新預算，Lisa 會聯絡供應商。我們下週二再開會。
notes: wrap up 表示收尾；action items 是會議後每個人要做的事。

title: Politely Disagreeing
en: I see your point, but I have some concerns about the cost. Perhaps we could consider a smaller pilot program before making a full commitment.
zh: 我明白您的觀點，但我對成本有些顧慮。或許我們可以在全面投入之前，先考慮一個規模較小的試行計畫。
notes: I see your point, but… 先肯定再提出不同意見；pilot program 指試行計畫。

title: Negotiating a Discount
en: If we increase our order volume to ten thousand units, would you be able to offer a volume discount? We are looking for a long-term partnership.
zh: 如果我們把訂購量提高到一萬個，您能提供數量折扣嗎？我們希望建立長期合作關係。
notes: If we…, would you be able to…? 是談判常見的條件交換句型。

title: Discussing Payment Terms
en: Our standard payment terms are net thirty days. However, we can extend them to sixty days if you sign a one-year contract.
zh: 我們的標準付款條件是30天付款。不過，如果您簽一年期合約，我們可以延長到60天。
notes: net 30 指收到發票後 30 天內付款；extend 延長。

title: Reaching an Agreement
en: I think we have reached a reasonable compromise. Let's put the terms in writing, and our legal team will review the draft.
zh: 我想我們已經達成合理的折衷方案。我們把條款寫成書面，由法務團隊審閱草稿。
notes: reach a compromise 達成妥協；put something in writing 書面化。

title: Explaining Quarterly Results
en: Revenue rose eight percent year over year, mainly driven by strong demand for our cloud services. However, operating margins declined slightly due to higher costs.
zh: 營收年增 8%，主要由雲端服務的強勁需求帶動。然而，由於成本上升，營業利益率略為下滑。
notes: year over year (YoY) 年增；driven by 由……帶動；operating margin 營業利益率。

title: Talking About a Forecast
en: We expect sales to remain flat in the next quarter. Our forecast assumes that interest rates will stay unchanged and consumer spending will recover gradually.
zh: 我們預期下一季銷售將持平。我們的預測假設利率維持不變，且消費支出會逐步回升。
notes: remain flat 持平；forecast 預測；assume 假設。

title: Cutting Costs
en: To improve profitability, management has decided to reduce travel expenses and postpone some hiring until next year.
zh: 為了提升獲利能力，管理階層決定減少差旅費用，並將部分招募延後到明年。
notes: profitability 獲利能力；postpone 延後 = put off。

title: Explaining a Supply Chain Disruption
en: The port congestion has disrupted our supply chain. We are looking into alternative shipping routes and increasing our safety stock.
zh: 港口壅塞打亂了我們的供應鏈。我們正在研究替代的運輸路線，並增加安全庫存。
notes: disrupt 打亂；look into 調查、研究；safety stock 安全庫存。

title: Tariffs and Sourcing
en: Because of the new tariffs, we are considering moving part of our production to Southeast Asia. This could help us lower costs and diversify risk.
zh: 由於新的關稅，我們正考慮把部分生產轉移到東南亞。這可能幫助我們降低成本並分散風險。
notes: tariff 關稅是近年美國新聞高頻字；diversify risk 分散風險。

title: Checking Inventory Levels
en: Our inventory levels are running low. Please place a purchase order today so that we do not run out of stock before the holiday season.
zh: 我們的庫存水位偏低。請今天下採購單，以免在假期旺季前缺貨。
notes: run low 快用完；run out of stock 缺貨；place an order 下訂單。

title: Launching a Marketing Campaign
en: Our new marketing campaign will target young professionals. We plan to focus on social media and measure the results by tracking conversion rates.
zh: 我們的新行銷活動將鎖定年輕上班族。我們計畫專注在社群媒體，並透過追蹤轉換率來評估成效。
notes: target 鎖定（客群）；conversion rate 轉換率。

title: Analyzing the Competition
en: Our main competitor has lowered its prices, so we need to differentiate ourselves through better service and product quality.
zh: 我們的主要競爭對手降價了，因此我們需要透過更好的服務與產品品質來做出差異化。
notes: competitor 競爭者；differentiate 差異化。

title: Gathering Customer Feedback
en: We conducted a survey of five hundred customers. Most respondents said they were satisfied, but many asked for faster delivery.
zh: 我們對五百位顧客進行了問卷調查。多數受訪者表示滿意，但很多人希望交貨更快。
notes: conduct a survey 進行調查；respondent 受訪者。

title: Job Interview: Strengths
en: One of my strengths is that I communicate well with cross-functional teams. In my previous role, I coordinated projects between engineering and sales.
zh: 我的優點之一是能與跨部門團隊良好溝通。在上一份工作中，我負責協調工程與業務之間的專案。
notes: cross-functional 跨部門；previous role 前一份職務；coordinate 協調。

title: Onboarding a New Employee
en: Welcome to the team! During your first week, you will complete the onboarding training and meet your mentor.
zh: 歡迎加入團隊！在第一週，你會完成新人訓練並認識你的導師。
notes: onboarding 新進人員到職流程；mentor 導師。

title: Performance Review
en: You exceeded your sales targets this year. For next year, I would like you to take on more leadership responsibilities.
zh: 你今年超越了業績目標。明年，我希望你承擔更多領導責任。
notes: exceed 超過；take on 承擔。

title: Handling a Complaint
en: I am sorry to hear that the product arrived damaged. We will send you a replacement right away at no extra charge.
zh: 很遺憾聽到產品送達時已損壞。我們會立即免費寄送替換品給您。
notes: replacement 替換品；at no extra charge 不另收費。

title: Processing a Refund
en: Your refund has been processed and should appear on your credit card statement within five to seven business days.
zh: 您的退款已處理完成，應會在 5 到 7 個工作天內出現在信用卡帳單上。
notes: business days 工作天；statement 對帳單。

title: Opening a Presentation
en: Thank you for coming. Today I will walk you through our market analysis and then share three recommendations.
zh: 感謝各位前來。今天我會帶大家了解我們的市場分析，接著分享三項建議。
notes: walk you through 帶你逐步了解；recommendations 建議。

title: Describing a Chart
en: As you can see from this chart, sales peaked in the third quarter and then dropped sharply in December.
zh: 從這張圖可以看到，銷售在第三季達到高峰，然後在十二月大幅下滑。
notes: peak 達到高峰；drop sharply 急遽下滑；描述趨勢的必備動詞。

title: Handling Q&A
en: That is a great question. I do not have the exact figures with me, but I will check and get back to you by the end of the day.
zh: 這是個好問題。我手邊沒有確切數字，但我會查一下，今天下班前回覆您。
notes: get back to you 之後回覆你；exact figures 確切數字。
phrases: by the end of the day

title: Explaining a Software Release
en: The new firmware version fixes several bugs and improves battery life. We will roll it out to all customers next month.
zh: 新版韌體修正了多個錯誤並改善電池續航。我們將在下個月推送給所有客戶。
notes: roll out 推出、上線；firmware 韌體。

title: Discussing AI Adoption
en: Many companies are adopting artificial intelligence to automate routine tasks. However, they must address concerns about data privacy and security.
zh: 許多公司正採用人工智慧來自動化例行工作。然而，他們必須處理資料隱私與資安方面的疑慮。
notes: adopt 採用；automate 自動化；address concerns 處理疑慮。

title: Semiconductor Demand
en: Demand for advanced chips remains strong as data centers expand. Several manufacturers are increasing capacity to meet orders.
zh: 隨著資料中心擴張，先進晶片的需求依然強勁。多家製造商正在擴充產能以滿足訂單。
notes: capacity 產能；meet orders 滿足訂單。半導體新聞常見。

title: The Fed and Interest Rates
en: The Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged this month. Officials said they would watch inflation and the job market closely before making further decisions.
zh: 聯準會本月維持利率不變。官員表示，在做出進一步決定前，會密切觀察通膨與就業市場。
notes: the Federal Reserve (the Fed) 美國聯準會；inflation 通膨；job market 就業市場。

title: Stock Market Update
en: Stocks rallied on Wall Street after technology shares posted strong gains. Investors were encouraged by better-than-expected earnings reports.
zh: 科技股大漲後，華爾街股市走揚。優於預期的財報讓投資人受到鼓舞。
notes: rally 反彈上漲；better-than-expected 優於預期；earnings 財報獲利。

title: Jobs Report
en: The economy added fewer jobs than economists had predicted last month, and the unemployment rate edged up slightly.
zh: 上個月經濟新增的就業人數少於經濟學家預測，失業率也小幅上升。
notes: edge up 小幅上升；unemployment rate 失業率。

title: Mergers and Acquisitions
en: The company announced plans to acquire a smaller rival for two billion dollars. The deal is still subject to regulatory approval.
zh: 該公司宣布計畫以二十億美元收購一家較小的競爭對手。這筆交易仍需經過監管機關核准。
notes: acquire 收購；subject to 須經過；regulatory approval 監管核准。

title: Checking In at a Hotel
en: I have a reservation under the name Chen for three nights. Could I also get a receipt for my company's expense report?
zh: 我用 Chen 的名字訂了三晚。可以也給我一張收據，讓我報公司的費用嗎？
notes: reservation under the name… 以某名字訂位；expense report 費用報告。

title: Rescheduling a Flight
en: My meeting was extended, so I need to change my flight to tomorrow morning. Is there an aisle seat available?
zh: 我的會議延長了，所以需要把班機改到明天早上。還有靠走道的座位嗎？
notes: extend 延長；aisle seat 靠走道座位；window seat 靠窗座位。

title: Small Talk with a Client
en: How was your trip from Chicago? If you have time after the meeting, we would love to take you out for dinner.
zh: 從芝加哥過來的旅途還順利嗎？如果會議後您有時間，我們很想請您吃晚餐。
notes: take someone out for dinner 請某人出去吃飯。和客戶寒暄常從旅程開始。

title: Reporting Project Status
en: The project is on track, but we are slightly behind schedule on testing. We need two more engineers to meet the deadline.
zh: 專案進度大致正常，但測試部分稍微落後。我們需要再兩位工程師才能趕上截止日。
notes: on track 進度正常；behind schedule 落後；meet the deadline 趕上期限。

title: Escalating a Risk
en: I would like to escalate this risk to senior management. If the supplier cannot deliver on time, the product launch may be delayed by a month.
zh: 我想把這個風險呈報給高階主管。如果供應商無法準時交貨，產品上市可能延後一個月。
notes: escalate 呈報、升級處理；on time 準時。

title: Allocating Resources
en: Given our limited resources, we should prioritize the features that customers request most often and postpone the rest.
zh: 考量我們有限的資源，我們應該優先處理客戶最常要求的功能，其餘的延後。
notes: given… 考量到；prioritize 排定優先順序。
